content: AUTOSAR communication shall support mechanism to keep a bus awake, and to be kept awake by a bus Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall support mechanism to keep the bus awake , thus indicating usage of a b us. Likely, AUTOSAR shall support mechanism to be k ept awake by the bus , thus indicating usage of a bus by other bus nodes . Note: this functionality is commonly called Network Management Rationale: Unless supported otherwise by hardware, a bus can only be put to sleep if all nodes on a bus agree. Therefore, a special bus specific protocol is needed to reach agreement: a node has to indicate if it needs the bus, or if it does not need the bus any more Use Case: Energy saving: switch off buses Dependencies : -- Supporting Material: --
